cells: **2026-09-17: ALL 25 LICENCE-PERMITTED — catalogue CC0 is MORE PERMISSIVE than the 10 AGPL3-header styles and the 4 silent styles, so the catalogue governs (OPERATOR RULING 2026-09-17, refined the same day to the more-permissive comparison); topology exclusions unchanged.** **SPLIT 2026-09-10 under the amended ruling.** The 4 styles with no licence line are shape 1 (file SILENT) and the pack page's CC0 governs them. The 9 that clear on their own header (6 CC0, 2 CC-0, 1 CC BY 4.0) are unchanged and never needed the ruling. The 10 carrying `AGPL3` are shape 3 and each needs a dated, named per-asset override; none exists, so all ten stay refused by name and `hair-licence-classify.ts` keeps enforcing it. PREVIOUSLY: MIXED — NOT CC0. Corrected 2026-08-11 (#330) by reading all 25 cached `.mhclo` headers:** 10 × `AGPL3` (**copyleft — hard refusal**), 6 × `CC0`, 2 × `CC-0`, 1 × `CC BY 4.0`, 1 × `CC_by`, 4 × **no licence line at all** (unspecified is a refusal). The previous **CC0 1.0** claim on this row was a *pack-page* reading, not a per-header read — the same error this ledger already corrected once for `makehuman-shirts01` (row above). **Do not glob this pack**: a directory-wide fit ships ten AGPL3 assets on the ledger's own authority. Usable subset = CC0/CC-BY **and** zero helper-vertex refs: the six `toigo_*` bobs. AGPL3 refusals: learning_anime_hair, culturalibre_hair_01/02, elvs_double_mh_braid, elvs_french_braid_variation, elvs_unkempt_french_braid, littleright_bobcut_hair, rehmanpolanski_hair_bun_brown, sonntag78_junglebook_hair, sonntag78_blond_with_headband. Unlicensed: the four `cortu_*`. **The gate is now machine-checkable, not prose**: `hair-licence-classify.ts` parses every staged `.mhclo`'s OWN header and helper-vertex refs (the non-uniform `CC0`/`CC-0`/`CC_by`/`CC BY 4.0`/`AGPL3`/absent spellings, and refs ≥ 13,380 vs the #318 stripped basemesh) and writes `.openclinxr/evidence/issue-330/hair-licence-classification.json` (25 rows). `faydaen_hair_1` (12 helper refs) and `culturalibre_hair_05` (4 helper refs) are additionally excluded on topology despite clean licences.
26 hairstyles, `.mhclo` + `.mhmat`, 217 MB. Authors: Cortu, culturalibre, Elvaerwyn, Faydaen, learning, littleright, punkduck, RehmanPolanski, sonntag78, MargaretToigo

`embed_library_hair.py` hair fit via `ClothesService.fit_clothes_to_human` — **fitted 2026-08-11 (#330):** `toigo_blunt_bob_with_bangs` on `body-param-adult_lean_female-library.glb` (`makeclothes_library_hair_toigo_blunt_bob_with_bangs_adult_lean_female_mesh`, 4,976 tris, weighted to `mixamorig:Head`), wired as an unconditional `body-param-cli.ts` finish step with a licence gate that refuses the bake when the selected style is not usable per its own header. The heavy-male class is a **recorded skip** — the licence-clean zero-helper subset is entirely feminine styles, so a bob on a male patient would regress realism; recorded in the catalog, never silent. CC-BY styles (`o4saken_long01`, `elvs_reverse_french_braid_bun`) are classified usable but carry an attribution obligation that must survive into any shipped build. **2026-08-14 (#381, slice 1 of #341): the SAME style is now fitted onto the MPFB2 cast actor** `mpfb-ob-patient-aisha.glb` by `materialize_mpfb_humanoid_candidate.py` (fit runs BEFORE the #318 helper strip, the peer fence's fit order; `makeclothes_library_hair_toigo_blunt_bob_with_bangs_mpfb_ob_patient_aisha_mesh`, 4,976 tris, weighted to the standard rig's `head` bone; bake-time licence re-read from the style's own `.mhclo` header via `read_hair_mhclo_licence` — refused if not CC0/CC-BY). The painted scalp region stays UNDER the fitted mesh. Kevin (male nurse) no longer stays on hair01: he consumes the named `mhair02` page-CC0 override (next row) — hair01's usable subset is still the six `toigo_*` bobs plus `culturalibre_hair_06` / two CC-BY styles, which is a pack-inventory fact, not a kevin skip.
**Keep.** CC0 is the cleanest posture available; replace only on quality grounds, not licence grounds. Mostly low-poly/stylised — likely to be a realism ceiling before it is a licence problem.
